test-machine: Manage and use registered test machines.
test-machine bridge-diagnose: Test each Terminal bridge feature and name what fails.
test-machine desktop-access: Open a test machine's remote desktop.
test-machine exec: Run one command on a test machine over SSH.
test-machine golden-capture: Save a test machine's clean state as a golden copy.
test-machine reset: Restore a test machine to its clean baseline.
test-machine screenshot: Capture a test machine's desktop as a PNG.
test-machine settings-replace: Replace a test machine's settings from a file.
test-machine verify: Check that a test machine is reachable and ready.
